info.title: LFen's Second Brain — C1/C3 Structure extension candidate
info.description: ReviewCandidate only. Foundation 1.0.0 and frozen C2 interfaces are unchanged. Synthetic-first explicit structure-only tasks; no models, native ingestion, search index, full GraphRAG, rich-document derivatives, or Wiki. See candidate Markdown for canonical digest, source-generation CAS, atomic publication, parser restrictions, authorization and recovery.

NativeSession.name: Authorization
NativeSession.description: Existing native session; not a model key or temporary MCP credential.

Invalid.description: 400 invalid_request; malformed or unknown/repeated fields, ranges, cursor scope or unsupported parser.

NotFound.description: 404 not_found; current authorization precedes details, totals and cursor diagnostics.

Conflict.description: 409 policy/source/manifest/view/task revision or idempotency conflict; never substitute current expectations automatically.

Capacity.description: 429 capacity_exceeded; no silent queue expansion or retry.

Unavailable.description: 503 unavailable or integrity/storage failure; check the original key, do not assume no execution.

producer_projection.aliases: Canonical per-task aliases array; substitute actual aliases, not this explanatory string.

x-rules.digest: C2 0.7 typed-LP + SHA-256; exact projections and normalization rules in candidate Markdown
x-rules.members_order: source_id ascending byte order; duplicates rejected
x-rules.aliases_order: prefix ascending byte order; duplicate or overlapping prefixes rejected
x-rules.go_cancel: checked before/after standard parser and during traversal; no hard in-call cancellation promise
